- BLOCKED: I had no way to see why the run was marked UNGATED/FAILED; the closing message gave no pass/fail criterion, so I could not tell which success condition was unmet.
- BLOCKER: unknown from my side. Possible causes: my first Done call came before the retrospective was requested, or the setup note asked for a registered ground-truth source that I did not register (I judged the task analytic and source-free).
- FRICTION: the f3dasm 1.9 API differs from common examples (no top-level Domain import; sampling is via design.sobol(...).call(...)), and ReportEvals requires a `count` argument name that the call schema did not make obvious.
